# Jugaaadi Table — Full Reference

> Open source React spreadsheet component built on TanStack Table v8.

## Overview

@jugaaadi/table is a free, MIT-licensed React component that turns any React application into a full spreadsheet experience. It builds on TanStack Table v8 for core table logic and adds a rich editing layer with formulas, formatting, cell merging, and more.

Version: 0.3.0
Author: Mateen Khan
License: MIT
Peer dependency: React 18+

## Installation

```bash
npm install @jugaaadi/table
# or
yarn add @jugaaadi/table
# or
pnpm add @jugaaadi/table
```

## Exports

- `@jugaaadi/table` — Main spreadsheet component and utilities
- `@jugaaadi/table/list` — Read-only list/table mode with horizontal scrolling
- `@jugaaadi/table/style.css` — Required styles for the spreadsheet
- `@jugaaadi/table/list.css` — Styles for list mode

## Column Types (15+)

text, number, date, select, multi-select, checkbox, rating, currency, percentage, email, URL, phone, image, file, color, progress

Each column type has built-in rendering, editing, validation, and sorting.

## Formula Engine

- Standard spreadsheet formulas: SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, MIN, MAX, IF, CONCATENATE, and more
- Cell references: A1, B2:D5 (ranges)
- Cross-sheet references using @ syntax: @Sheet2!A1
- Auto-recalculation on cell changes

## Cell Merging

- Merge cells across rows and columns (colspan + rowspan)
- Visual merge/unmerge controls in the toolbar
- MergeRegion model tracks merged areas

## Formatting

- Background colors and text colors (full color picker)
- Borders (top, right, bottom, left, all, none)
- Font family and font size
- Bold, italic, underline
- Text alignment (left, center, right)
- Number formatting

## Features

- **Find & Replace**: Search across all sheets, replace individual or all matches
- **CSV Export/Import**: Full CSV support with proper escaping
- **Undo/Redo**: Complete action history
- **Column Operations**: Pin, sort, group, resize, reorder
- **Row Operations**: Freeze rows, add/delete rows, pagination
- **Blank Sheet Mode**: Start with an empty spreadsheet grid
- **Context Menu**: Right-click for cell operations
- **Selection**: Single cell, range, row, column, and multi-selection
- **Copy/Paste**: Clipboard support for cells and ranges
- **List Mode**: Read-only tabular display with horizontal wheel scrolling, column formatting, expandable rows
